channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: Big Training, Small Budget: Get Resourceful in Your Community
item.description: Host Frank Ricci welcomes David Polikoff, Robert “RJ” James, and Dave McGlynn to discuss creating effective training props without breaking the budget.

item.title: IL Senior Living Center Forced to Evacuate After Sprinkler System Leaks
item.description: Sterling's Shepherd Premier Senior Living was evacuated due to a broken sprinkler head causing water hazards.

item.title: Baker City (OR) Fire Chief Suggests City Require ‘Lock Boxes’ at Some Businesses to Give Firefighters Faster Access
item.description: Baker City Fire Chief Michael Carlson proposed requiring businesses to install lock boxes for easier access during emergencies. Councilors support surveying business owners before considering the ordinance.

item.title: Gas Smell at Nursing Home Was Reported Hours Before Deadly Explosion, Report Says
item.description: A preliminary NTSB report details a gas odor report at a Pennsylvania nursing home hours before a deadly explosion, raising questions about utility response and safety management.

item.title: Fire at CA Metal Recycling Center Leads to Shelter-in-Place Advisory
item.description: Los Angeles County firefighters battled a large fire at P&T Metals in South El Monte on Jan. 28, prompting a shelter-in-place order for nearby residents due to hazardous smoke conditions.

item.title: MA Firefighter Falls Through Floor Battling Two-Alarm House Fire
item.description: The Hull Fire Department responded to a two-alarm fire at an unoccupied home under renovation.

item.title: Kansas City (MO) Fire Crews Battle 11th Fire at Historic Parade Park Since November
item.description: Kansas City firefighters responded to a fire at the vacant Parade Park complex, marking the 11th blaze since Thanksgiving.

item.title: IA Firefighter Falls Through Attic Floor While Fighting House Fire
item.description: A Davenport firefighter sustained minor injuries after falling through an attic floor while battling a fire on Marquette Street.

item.title: One Dead After MO House Explosion
item.description: One person died in a house fire and explosion in Smithville on Wednesday. Multiple fire districts responded, and the Missouri State Fire Marshal's Office will investigate.

item.title: NY Firefighters Rescue Trapped Resident From Burning Building
item.description: A two-alarm kitchen fire at Royal Garden Apartments in Town of Ulster displaced 11 residents. Firefighters rescued one trapped resident, and the Red Cross provided aid to 15 affected individuals.
